t2.title: It better to be an only child or to have siblings
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it better to be an only child or to have siblings?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The question of whether it is better to be an only child or have siblings is one that many people debate.

Being an only child has several advantages. Parents can focus all their attention and resources on one child, often providing better educational opportunities and more personal time. Only children may also develop independence and maturity faster as they spend more time with adults.

On the other hand, having siblings offers unique benefits. Brothers and sisters provide companionship and emotional support throughout life. Children with siblings learn important social skills like sharing, compromise, and conflict resolution from an early age. These skills are valuable in school and later in the workplace.

From my perspective, having siblings is preferable. While only children may have material advantages, the lifelong bond between siblings is irreplaceable. My own siblings have been my best friends and supporters through difficult times.

In conclusion, both situations have merits, but the social and emotional benefits of having siblings make it the better option for most people.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear AquaFit Management,

I am writing to you as a new member of the AquaFit Swimming Center. Overall, I'm enjoying the facilities. The pool is clean, and the staff are friendly. However, I have a few suggestions.

Firstly, the lane swimming hours are not ideal for me. I work during the day, so I can only swim in the evenings, but it's often very crowded then. Perhaps you could extend the lane swimming hours later into the evening? Also, the water quality is usually good, but sometimes it seems a little cloudy.

In terms of improvements, I think it would be great if you offered swimming lessons for adults. I would be very interested in improving my technique. Also, a small cafe or vending machine would be useful for after my swim.

Thank you for considering my suggestions.

Sincerely,
A New Member
t2.sampleB2: Have you ever wished for a brother or sister — or perhaps been secretly glad you didn't have one? The debate over whether it is better to be an only child or to grow up with siblings is one that never seems to go away. There are clear upsides to being an only child. With no one to compete with, only children tend to get their parents' full attention, along with more space, time and resources. This often gives them a head start at school and helps them become independent from an early age. On the other hand, having siblings brings something money simply cannot buy: constant company. Growing up alongside brothers and sisters teaches you to share, to argue and make up, and to stand on your own two feet. These everyday lessons build social skills that last a lifetime. In my view, neither option is truly better — it all comes down to the family. A loving home can turn either situation into a happy childhood. What matters most is not how many children there are, but how much care and attention they receive.
t2.uzSample:
Yagona farzand bo'lish yaxshimi yoki aka-uka va opa-singillarga ega bo'lishmi degan savol ko'pchilikni bahsga chorlaydi.

Yagona farzand bo'lishning bir qator afzalliklari bor. Ota-onalar butun e'tiborini va resurslarini bitta bolaga qaratishi mumkin, ko'pincha yaxshiroq ta'lim olish imkoniyatlarini va ko'proq shaxsiy vaqtni ta'minlaydi. Yagona farzandlar kattalar bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazganligi sababli mustaqillik va yetuklikni tezroq rivojlantirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, aka-uka va opa-singillarga ega bo'lish o'ziga xos afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Aka-uka va opa-singillar hayot davomida hamrohlik va hissiy yordam beradi. Aka-uka va opa-singillari bo'lgan bolalar erta yoshdan boshlab baham ko'rish, murosaga kelish va nizolarni hal qilish kabi muhim ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni o'rganadilar. Bu ko'nikmalar maktabda va keyinchalik ish joyida qimmatlidir.

Mening nuqtai nazarimga ko'ra, aka-uka va opa-singillarga ega bo'lish afzalroq. Yagona farzandlar moddiy afzalliklarga ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, aka-uka va opa-singillar o'rtasidagi umrbod rishta o'rnini bosib bo'lmaydi. Mening aka-uka va opa-singillarim qiyin paytlarda mening eng yaxshi do'stlarim va tarafdorlarim bo'lishgan.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, har ikki vaziyatning ham afzalliklari bor, lekin aka-uka va opa-singillarga ega bo'lishning ijtimoiy va hissiy foydalari uni ko'pchilik uchun yaxshiroq variantga aylantiradi.

Salom!

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom!
Menga basseyn yoqadi, va suvi yaxshi. Men har kuni suzaman. Lekin vaqti menga to'g'ri kelmaydi. Men ertalab suzmoqchiman, lekin u yopiq. Men ertalab ko'proq vaqt bo'lishini xohlayman. Yana, menga kafe kerak. Suzgandan keyin qornim ochadi.
Rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli AquaFit rahbariyati,

Men sizga AquaFit Suzish Markazining yangi a'zosi sifatida murojaat qilyapman. Umuman olganda, menga qulayliklar yoqadi. Hovuz toza va xodimlar do'stona munosabatda. Biroq, menda bir nechta takliflar bor.

Birinchidan, yo'lakda suzish soatlari men uchun ideal emas. Men kunduzi ishlayman, shuning uchun faqat kechqurun suza olaman, lekin u vaqtda odamlar ko'p bo'ladi. Ehtimol, yo'lakda suzish soatlarini kechroqqa uzaytirsangiz bo'lardi? Bundan tashqari, suv sifati odatda yaxshi, lekin ba'zida biroz loyqa bo'lib qoladi.

Yaxshilash nuqtai nazaridan, agar siz kattalar uchun suzish darslarini taklif qilsangiz, juda yaxshi bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Men o'z texnikamni yaxshilashga juda qiziqardim. Shuningdek, suzishdan keyin kichik kafe yoki avtomat savdo mashinasi foydali bo'lardi.

Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Yangi A'zo
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli AquaFit rahbariyati,

Men AquaFit Suzish Markazi jamiyatiga yaqinda qo'shilgan a'zo sifatida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Ta'kidlashim kerakki, dastlabki taassurotlarim asosan ijobiy bo'ldi, ayniqsa, binolarning tozaligi va xodimlaringiz tomonidan yaratilgan do'stona muhit meni juda xursand qildi.

Biroq, a'zolarning tajribasini yanada yaxshilashga yordam beradi deb hisoblagan bir nechta kuzatuvlarim va takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, belgilangan suzish soatlarini qadrlasam ham, ular talabchan ish jadvaliga ega bo'lgan shaxslarga yetarli darajada mos kelmaydi deb o'ylayman. Kechki mashg'ulotlar tez-tez gavjum bo'lib, mashq sifatini pasaytiradi. Ushbu soatlarni uzaytirish yoki erta tongda mashg'ulotlar tashkil etish sezilarli yaxshilanish bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, vaqti-vaqti bilan suvning tiniqligida ozgina o'zgarishlarni sezdim, bu e'tiborga loyiq.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, turli xil mahorat darajalariga mo'ljallangan tuzilgan kattalar uchun suzish darslarini joriy etish juda qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi deb hisoblayman. Ko'pgina a'zolar, shu jumladan men ham, o'z texnikamizni takomillashtirishda professional rahbarlikdan shubhasiz foyda ko'rishadi. Nihoyat, sog'lom gazaklar va ichimliklar taklif qiladigan kichik joyida kafe tashkil etish mashqdan keyin kuch tiklash uchun qulay bo'ladi.

Vaqtingiz va e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat. Fikr-mulohazalarim konstruktiv qabul qilinishiga ishonaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrli a'zo

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who wants to learn swimming. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hi there! I heard you want to learn swimming – that's absolutely great! I just joined a swimming pool near my house and they offer excellent beginner classes. The instructors are really patient and helpful. You should definitely sign up – it's never too late to learn! Let me know if you want more info! Best wishes!

Hi Ozoda,
I swim. Pool is good. Water is good. You swim too! It is fun.
Bye!
t11.sampleA2:

Bye,
Laylo Nazarova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the swimming center management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear AquaFit Management, Thank you for welcoming me to your swimming center. I am writing to share my feedback after using your facilities for the past month. I am thoroughly impressed with the cleanliness of the pool and the changing rooms. The water temperature is always comfortable, and the lifeguards are attentive and professional. I particularly enjoy the early morning lane swimming sessions. However, I have some suggestions for improvement. The pool can become quite crowded during evening hours, so perhaps you could consider extending lane swimming times. Additionally, offering adult swimming lessons would benefit members who are not confident swimmers. I would also appreciate having lockers available for longer-term rental rather than daily use only. Thank you for considering my feedback. Yours sincerely, Laylo Nazarova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi AquaFit,

Pool good. Water good. Time ok.

More time swim? More swim good.

Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hi AquaFit,

Thank you for the welcome letter. I like the pool. The water is good and clean. The swimming time is okay, but sometimes it is busy.

I think you need more time for swimming in the morning. And maybe swimming lessons for adults because some people can't swim very well.

Thank you.

Bye,

Laylo Nazarova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear AquaFit Management,

Thank you for your welcome. I am writing to give you some feedback about the swimming pool. I think the pool is very good. It is clean and the water quality is fine. The lane swimming hours are mostly suitable for me.

However, I have a few suggestions. Sometimes the pool is too crowded, especially in the evenings. So, maybe you could have more lane swimming times later. Also, I think it would be good to offer swimming lessons for adults who aren't very good swimmers. This could be a useful service.

Thank you for reading my letter.

Yours sincerely,

Laylo Nazarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear AquaFit Management, Thank you for the warm welcome to your swimming center. Having used the facilities for a month now, I would like to share a few thoughts. On the whole, I have been very impressed. The pool is spotlessly clean, the water quality is excellent, and the changing rooms are well maintained. The staff are friendly and always on hand to help. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. The lane swimming hours do not quite suit those of us who work full-time, so extending the evening sessions would make a real difference. I would also love to see you lay on adult swimming lessons, as many members would benefit from proper coaching. A wider range of locker sizes would be a welcome touch too. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
